lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense distribution of high-luminance, roughly circular spots originating posterior to the branchial region. These blobs are arranged in approximately horizontal rows that increase in diameter and spatial separation as they progress towards the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating a grid-like configuration of high-contrast anchor nodes, most prominent in the mid-flank section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient featuring highlights on the superior edge and pronounced shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the left pectoral fin displays multiple irregular notches and serrations, indicating significant previous mechanical trauma or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A small remora is visible in close proximity to the ventral surface of the shark, positioned just below the origin of the pectoral fin.
